CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_reject_history_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog history is append-only' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END $function$
